results.title: A Dog's Purpose
results.overview: A dog goes on quest to discover his purpose in life over the course of several lifetimes with multiple owners.

results.title: Split
results.overview: Though Kevin has evidenced 23 personalities to his trusted psychiatrist, Dr. Fletcher, there remains one still submerged who is set to materialize and dominate all the others. Compelled to abduct three teenage girls led by the willful, observant Casey, Kevin reaches a war for survival among all of those contained within him — as well as everyone around him — as the walls between his compartments shatter apart.

results.title: Take the 10
results.overview: A day in the life of two best friends, a drug dealer, and a store manager collide at a hip-hop concert in the Inland Empire.

results.title: Detour
results.overview: A young law student, grieving for his dying mother, struggles to decide whether he should kill his unfaithful step-father.

results.title: Walking Out
results.overview: A city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, only for the strained trip to become a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear.

results.title: Roxanne Roxanne
results.overview: The most feared battle emcee in the early 1980s in Queens, New York, was a fierce teenager from the Queensbridge projects. At the age of 14, Roxanne Shanté was well on her way to becoming a hip-hop legend, as she hustled to provide for her family while defending herself from the dangers of the street.

results.title: The Polka King
results.overview: Local Pennsylvania polka legend Jan Lewan develops a plan to get rich that shocks his fans and lands him in jail.

results.title: To the Bone
results.overview: A young woman dealing with anorexia meets an unconventional doctor who challenges her to face her condition and embrace life.

results.title: Deidra & Laney Rob a Train
results.overview: After their mother ends up in jail, two sisters turn to train robbery in order to support their family.

results.title: Strong Island
results.overview: Examining the violent death of the filmmaker’s brother and the judicial system that allowed his killer to go free, this documentary interrogates murderous fear and racialized perception, and re-imagines the wreckage in catastrophe’s wake, challenging us to change.

results.title: Marjorie Prime
results.overview: A service which creates holographic projections of late family members allows an elderly woman to spend time with a younger version of her deceased husband.

results.title: Burning Sands
results.overview: Deep into Hell Week, a favored pledgee is torn between honoring his code of silence or standing up against the intensifying violence of underground hazing.

results.title: Justice League Dark
results.overview: When innocent civilians begin committing unthinkable crimes across Metropolis, Gotham City and beyond, Batman must call upon mystical counterparts to eradicate this demonic threat to the planet; enter Justice League Dark. This team of Dark Arts specialists must unravel the mystery of Earth's supernatural plague and contend with the rising, powerful villainous forces behind the siege—before it's too late for all of mankind.

results.title: Girlfriend's Day
results.overview: When he's caught up in a deadly conspiracy, an unemployed greeting card writer must create the perfect card for a new holiday to save his skin.

results.title: Surf's Up 2: WaveMania
results.overview: Cody, Chicken Joe and Lani are back in their most epic adventure yet! The most radical surfing dream team, The Hang Five puts Cody and his friends to the test and teaches them the meaning of teamwork as they journey to the most legendary surfing spot on the planet.

results.title: The Space Between Us
results.overview: A young man raised by scientists on Mars returns to Earth to find his father.

results.title: The Incredible Jessica James
results.overview: Burned by a bad breakup, a struggling New York City playwright makes an unlikely connection with a divorced app designer she meets on a blind date.

results.title: iBoy
results.overview: After an accident, Tom wakes from a coma to discover that fragments of his smart phone have been embedded in his head, and worse, that returning to normal teenage life is impossible because he has developed a strange set of super powers.

results.title: T2 Trainspotting
results.overview: After 20 years abroad, Mark Renton returns to Scotland and reunites with his old friends Sick Boy, Spud and Begbie.

results.title: Bill Burr: Walk Your Way Out
results.original_title: Bill Burr: Walk Your Way Out
results.overview: No-nonsense comic Bill Burr takes the stage in Nashville and riffs on fast food, overpopulation, dictators and gorilla sign language.
